"""
Minimal serializable data model interfaces to decouple parsers and writers.

This module defines Protocols that concrete User/Weibo classes implement,
ensuring parsers return only contract-compliant data and writers depend only
on the interface, not concrete implementations.
"""
from typing import Protocol, Dict, Any, List, Optional


class DataRecord(Protocol):
    """Base protocol for all parsed data records."""

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Convert the record to a serializable dictionary."""
        ...


class UserRecord(DataRecord, Protocol):
    """
    Protocol for user records returned by parsers.

    This protocol is designed to match the subset of attributes
    used by writers and downstream components. It avoids
    tight coupling to the concrete User class.
    """

    id: str
    nickname: str
    gender: Optional[str]
    location: Optional[str]
    birthday: Optional[str]
    description: Optional[str]
    verified_reason: Optional[str]
    talent: Optional[str]
    education: Optional[str]
    work: Optional[str]
    weibo_num: int
    following: int
    followers: int

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a serializable representation."""
        ...


class WeiboRecord(DataRecord, Protocol):
    """
    Protocol for weibo records returned by parsers.

    This protocol is designed to match the subset of attributes
    used by writers and downstream components. It avoids
    tight coupling to the concrete Weibo class.
    """

    id: str
    content: str
    article_url: Optional[str]
    original_pictures: str
    retweet_pictures: str
    original: bool
    video_url: Optional[str]
    original_pictures_list: Optional[List[str]]
    retweet_pictures_list: Optional[List[str]]
    media: Dict[str, Any]
    publish_place: str
    publish_time: str
    publish_tool: str
    up_num: int
    retweet_num: int
    comment_num: int

    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return a serializable representation."""
        ...
